COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

4. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.
   B. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   D. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.
   B. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   D. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the .
   D. Treat Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   B. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   D. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.

10. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   B. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Action Research never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to Action Research as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research.

12. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.
   B. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict Resolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Responsible Decision Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
